scope_caveat: This is a bounded, hash-bound review inventory, not a completeness claim, theorem-truth certification, canonical-ID allocation, benchmark release, split, scorer, proof receipt, or authorization to assign ATV/execution work. Missing candidates mean only that the listed normalized aliases had zero literal match in the same-domain Stage0 name-plus-statement snapshot. Existing collisions are adjudication candidates, not automatic merge/delete instructions. Every record remains review_candidate_only and benchmark_ready=false until independent identity, statement, evidence, rights, and task gates pass.

route_definitions.CF: Conditional or hardness-assumption catalog route; never ordinary proved-theorem credit.
route_definitions.OC: Open-conjecture or open-problem catalog route; eligible only for a separately governed open-challenge task.
route_definitions.PF: Proof-form candidate route for a known mathematical or computer-science result; exact statement and evidence still required.
route_definitions.PH: Physics theorem candidate route; model, regime, assumptions, units or normalization, evidence, and oracle still required.

imbalance_notes: Mathematics has ten custom top-level classes; differential equations plus 'other important areas' account for 476/1601 records.
Physics has 208 subcategories; 85 have only one or two records, while condensed matter, relativity, and quantum field theory account for 648/1263 records.
Computer science has 40 subcategories: 38 contain exactly ten records and two contain nine; every generated CS category retains a leading '. ' artifact.
Taxonomy crosswalk coverage, catalog coverage, atomic-claim coverage, and benchmark-task coverage are separate denominators.
